title: Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2610.17786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study industrial fault diagnosis as a classification task that assigns sensor time-series windows to predefined health states or fault types. Scarce labels and changing operating conditions make repeated training of specialized classifiers costly. Yet structures such as periodicity, trends, and transients can remain diagnostically informative and be examined through reusable analytical tools. LLM agents can select and interpret these tools, but fixed rules or training-derived guidance may not resolve each signal's ambiguity, while unconstrained interpretation may overstate weak or conflicting results. We introduce Agentic4PDM, a framework that separates adaptive investigation from control over evidence use. LLM agents compare each signal with labeled references from every candidate class, identify unresolved distinctions, and propose follow-up measurements. A deterministic software controller, called the host, enforces contract-checke

translated_title: Agentic4PDM：面向工业故障诊断的主机治理式证据可采性框架
translated_abstract: 我们将工业故障诊断视为一个分类任务，即把传感器时间序列窗口分配到预定义的健康状态或故障类型中。标签稀缺和运行条件不断变化，使得反复训练专用分类器的成本高昂。然而，周期性、趋势和瞬态等结构仍可能保留诊断信息，并可通过可复用的分析工具加以检验。LLM智能体能够选择并解释这些工具，但固定规则或源自训练的指导可能无法化解每个信号的歧义，而不受约束的解释则可能夸大微弱或相互矛盾的结果。我们提出Agentic4PDM，这是一个将自适应调查与证据使用控制相分离的框架。LLM智能体将每个信号与来自所有候选类别的带标签参考进行比较，识别尚未解决的区分点，并提出后续测量建议。一个名为“主机”的确定性软件控制器强制执行合同检查（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Agentic4PDM框架将LLM智能体的自适应信号调查与确定性软件主机对证据可采性的严格管控相分离，从而在标签稀缺和运行条件多变的工业故障诊断中避免夸大微弱或矛盾的检测结果。
en_tdlr: Agentic4PDM separates adaptive LLM-agent signal investigation from a deterministic host controller governing evidence admissibility, enabling reliable industrial fault diagnosis under scarce labels and shifting operating conditions.
